content.text: UTSANG 2K26 was the IEEE Warangal Zonal Student Congress hosted by the IEEE Student Branch of SR University in collaboration with the IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Activities Committee, bringing together 120 participants for technical sessions, leadership addresses, and networking.

description:
Dear Members,

Greetings!

One Platform. Many Colleges. Endless Connections and Opportunities!

✨ IEEE Hyderabad Section SAC proudly presents UTSANG 2K26 – Warangal Zonal Congress ✨

Theme: AI-Driven Innovation in Sustainable and Resilient Emerging Technologies

📅 11th April 2026
⏰ 9:30 AM – 5:00 PM
📍 SR University, Warangal

* Meet students from different colleges, distinguished guests, IEEE leaders, faculty, and industry experts. ✨
* Interaction with students from different colleges. 🤝
* A chance to connect with IEEE leaders and student communities. 🌐
* Complimentary lunch will be provided to all participants. 🍽️

💰 Registration Fee:
₹200 – IEEE Members
₹300 – Non-IEEE Members

🔥 Limited seats only!

Register here: https://sru-ieee-sb.github.io/Utsang-2k26/
